title: Building the Foundation for a Scalable India Technology Center
summary: Discover how Concentrix launched a fully operational India technology center in 90 days through a scalable Build-Operate-Transfer approach.
body_markdown:
## Outcomes


35+ Skilled Engineers Onboarded - Rapidly assembled a high-performing engineering team.


Development Center Operational in 90 Days - Established a fully operational development center in just 90 days.


Full Regulatory Compliance Achieved - Secured all licenses, registrations, and regulatory approvals.


Scalable Operating Model Established - Built governance and operational foundations for future growth.


Seamless Transition to Client Ownership - Transitioned operations smoothly while ensuring business continuity.


**Featured Outcome**


Delivered a fully operational development center and onboarded 35+ engineers within 90 days, creating a high-performance technology hub aligned with industry best practices.
